{{Quote|So what exactly was this message from Karrde?''"<br />"''[&hellip;] We're to meet him and Booster at Domgrin as quickly as we can get there.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
'''Domgrin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|196|Domgrin}}</ref> that was located within the [[Domgrin system/Legends|Domgrin system]], a part of the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located relatively close to the planet [[Gonmore]].<ref name="CSWE" />
